title: Frappe par production skills: architecture review, code review, test strategy
summary: Teen production-grade skills banao jinhe architect, reviewer aur tester agents preload karte hain: architecture-review (requirement se ADR, core DocType change vs country app vs integration app, controller vs doc_events, synchronous vs frappe.enqueue decide karna), code-review (canonical findings format mein house standards ke against Frappe diff, is project mein bundled /code-review ko replace karti hai), aur test-strategy (FrappeTestCase, unittest, frappe.set_user, query counter aur bench run-tests flags par mapped aath-category plan). Har ek templates, zero-dependency validator aur real spice_lite bench par measure kiye behaviour se bane golden cases ke saath ship hoti hai.
prerequisites: Ek working bench jisme spice_lite test.localhost par ho (`AI-SDLC-frappe/sample-app/scripts/setup-bench.sh`)
Whitelisted methods, DocType JSON aur FrappeTestCase tests padhne mein comfort

concepts.heading: Skill ek procedure hai plus woh files jo use chahiye
concepts.body_md:
**Skill** ek directory hai, prompt nahi. `.claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` mein YAML frontmatter aur ek Markdown procedure hota hai; directory ki baaki files tabhi padhi ya chalayi jaati hain jab procedure unki taraf point kare. `build/CLAUDE_CODE_FACTS.md` §2 se:

- **description** (plus `when_to_use`) hamesha context mein rehta hai, taaki Claude skill load karne ka decide kar sake. Listing mein yeh jodi 1,536 characters par truncate hoti hai, isliye trigger situations jaldi naam lo: "DocType schema, `hooks.py`, permissions, background jobs".
- **body** tab load hota hai jab skill invoke hoti hai (`/code-review`, ya description se automatically) aur session ke liye context mein rehta hai.
- **Supporting files** (`frappe-options.md`, `review-checklist.md`, `tooling-map.md`) on demand padhi jaati hain. **Scripts** execute hote hain, load nahi, isliye 200-line validator koi context nahi khata.
- `SKILL.md` ko 500 lines se kam rakho aur baaki link karo.

Is module ki har skill ka shape ek jaisa hai:

```text
.claude/skills/architecture-review/
├── SKILL.md            # when, inputs, procedure, rules
├── frappe-options.md   # the Frappe decision axes with verified v15 behaviour
├── ADR_TEMPLATE.md     # output structure
├── checklist.md        # self-check before writing
├── examples/           # a real input and the expected output
└── scripts/            # zero-dependency Node validator + node:test tests
```

Procedure encode karta hai ki ek senior Frappe engineer **is repository mein** kaam kaise karta hai: `api/fhir.py` se pehle `context/architecture/overview.md` padho, ek whitelisted method ko mapper, controller, DocType JSON aur `hooks.py` ke through trace karo, framework behaviour memory se nahi balki bench ke `apps/frappe` source mein check karo. Supporting files woh hisse rakhti hain jo apne schedule par badalte hain; naya Frappe trap procedure chhue bina `frappe-options.md` mein jaata hai.

Yahan use hua frontmatter, sab documented list se: `name`, `description`, `when_to_use`, `argument-hint`, `allowed-tools`, `disallowed-tools`. Teeno mein se koi `disable-model-invocation: true` set nahi karti: us flag wali skill preload nahi ho sakti, aur architect, reviewer aur tester agents (module 05-agent-roster) in skills ko apne `skills:` field se preload karte hain.

concepts.heading: Skill ko real input dena: $ARGUMENTS aur !`cmd` injection
concepts.body_md:
Review skill utni hi achhi hai jitna achha diff use dikhta hai. Do documented mechanisms model ke reasoning shuru karne se pehle input uske saamne rakhte hain:

- **`$ARGUMENTS`** command ke baad ki har cheez se replace hota hai (`/code-review main` se `main` milta hai). `$0` *pehla* argument hai. Placeholder na ho toh Claude Code `ARGUMENTS: <value>` append karta hai.
- Line ki shuruaat mein **`` !`command` ``** content bheje jaane se *pehle* chalta hai, aur uska output placeholder ko replace karta hai. Yeh permission rules ke against check hota hai; auto mode ke bahar jo allowed nahi woh invocation abort kar deta hai, jaise non-zero exit karta hai. `allowed-tools` ise skill ke liye pre-approve karta hai.

`code-review/SKILL.md` yeh inject karti hai:

```markdown
!`git diff --stat HEAD -- sample-app`
!`git status --short -- sample-app`
!`git diff HEAD -- sample-app`
```

Teeno skill ke `allowed-tools` mein `Bash(git diff *)` / `Bash(git status *)` se match karte hain, isliye skill `AI-SDLC-frappe/` ke andar se bina prompt ke load hoti hai (pathspec working directory ke relative hai, aur git repository root ek level upar ho sakta hai).

Frappe app par kaatne wali details:

1. **Untracked files `git diff` ko dikhti nahi.** Jo patch nayi DocType folder jodta hai woh `git add -N sample-app` tak kuch nahi dikhata. Skill `git status` ki har `??` entry bhi padhti hai.
2. **Diff ko set ki tarah padhna chahiye.** Matching `patches.txt` hunk ke bina DocType JSON hunk ek finding hai, isliye procedure kisi ko bhi review karne se pehle files ko Python, DocType JSON, `patches.txt`, `hooks.py`, fixtures aur tests mein sort karta hai.
3. **Arguments untrusted hain.** `git diff <base>...HEAD` banne se pehle base ref ko `^[A-Za-z0-9._/~^-]+$` ke against validate kiya jaata hai.
4. **`allowed-tools` pre-approve karta hai; restrict nahi karta.** `code-review` `disallowed-tools: Edit Write NotebookEdit` set karti hai taaki skill active rehte hue reviewer edit na kar sake.

Isliye practically: jo model ko guess nahi karna chahiye woh inject karo, jo user type kare use validate karo, aur hard limit ke liye `disallowed-tools` use karo.

concepts.heading: Frappe platform par architecture decisions: change kahan rehta hai?
concepts.body_md:
Spice-style platform par zyadatar architecture sawaal placement ke sawaal hote hain, aur generic "design review" prompts unhe kabhi nahi poochte. `architecture-review` model se `frappe-options.md` ka har axis explicitly decide karwati hai:

1. **Core, country app, integration app, ya core extension point.** Jo field har country ko chahiye woh core DocType change hai (plus patch jab data badalna ho). Jo field ek country ko chahiye woh us country ke app mein Custom Field / Property Setter fixture hai. Jo bhi external system se baat kare (telephony, national ID registry, REST par ERPNext) woh `required_apps = ["spice_lite"]` wala integration app hai, jise `install_app` pehle install karta hai.
2. **Controller method ya `doc_events`.** DocType ke apne app ke rules controller mein rehte hain; kisi doosre app ka behaviour us app ke `hooks.py` mein `doc_events` se register hota hai. `override_doctype_class` avoid kiya jaata hai: sirf ek app jeet sakta hai.
3. **Synchronous ya `frappe.enqueue`.** External calls explicit `queue`, `timeout`, `job_id`, `deduplicate=True` ke saath queue mein jaati hain, aur `enqueue_after_commit=True` jab job triggering document padhta ho.

Worked example (ADR-0002, Kenya deployment ke liye national health ID) ke liye real code padhne se do facts mile jo sirf-placement wala jawab miss karta:

- `api/fhir.py:33` mein `PATIENT_FIELDS` ek fixed list hai aur `patient_to_fhir` ek identifier emit karta hai (`mappers.py:52`), isliye country Custom Field kabhi API tak nahi pahunchta. Decision ek chhota core **extension point** jodta hai, ek app-defined `hooks.py` key jo `frappe.get_hooks` se padhi jaati hai.
- `parse_token` token ka system phenk deta hai (`mappers.py:113`): `parse_token('urn:spice:nhid|12345678')` `'12345678'` return karta hai, jise `search_patients` phir MRN ki tarah dhoondhta hai. Yeh risk AR-001 hai, aur yeh aaj exist karta hai.

Frappe source bhi evidence hai: ADR `apps/frappe/frappe/core/doctype/rq_job/rq_job.py:170` (`arguments=frappe.as_json(job.kwargs)`) cite karta hai yeh justify karne ke liye ki verification job ko sirf document name pass kiya jaaye, kyonki job arguments desk mein dikhte hain. Validator ka `--bench` flag un citations ko bench ke against check karta hai, `--repo` repository wale.

concepts.heading: Frappe diffs review karna: jo CI nahi dekhta
concepts.body_md:
Claude Code ek bundled `/code-review` ship karta hai. Docs ke hisaab se (`build/CLAUDE_CODE_FACTS.md` mein addendum), usi naam ki project skill project ke andar bundled command ko **replace** karti hai, lekin uske alias ko nahi: `/review` ab bhi bundled wala chalata hai. `AI-SDLC-frappe/` ke andar `/code-review` house review chalata hai: `context/standards/*` rule numbers, canonical findings table, har category ka `no findings`, aur `review-standards.md` se nikala verdict. Personal `~/.claude/skills/code-review/` project wale se jeet-ta hai (personal > project), aur jab machines ke beech reviews alag hon toh sabse pehle yahi check karna hai.

Frappe-specific review ki wajah measured hai, assumed nahi. Is module ka har golden patch app par apply kiya gaya aur bench lock ke under suite chalaya gaya:

| Patch | `bench run-tests --app spice_lite` | Probe ne kya dikhaya |
|---|---|---|
| f-string `frappe.db.sql` ke saath guest lookup | 46, OK | Guest ke roop mein, injected `name` ne 3 mein se 3 patients return kiye; `O'Brien` ne `psycopg2.errors.SyntaxError` raise kiya |
| naye whitelisted read mein `frappe.get_all` | 46, OK | `norole@spice-lite.test` ko values ke saath 200 mila; `lastn` ne usi user ko 403 diya |
| `sl_patient.json` mein `reqd` field joda, koi patch nahi | 46, OK | scratch site par `bench migrate` ke baad: `Ran 27 tests`, `FAILED (errors=14)`, sab `MandatoryError ... national_id` |
| `frappe.log_error` mein values | 46, OK | har rejected observation ke liye `value=72.0` wali ek Error Log row |
| audit logger par `with_more_info=True` | 46, OK | audit log line mein `Form Dict: {'family': ..., 'identifier': ...}` append hua |

Har baar CI green hai. DocType wala case sabse zyada sikhata hai: `bench run-tests` migrate nahi karta, isliye schema change suite ko tab tak nahi dikhta jab tak koi `bench migrate` nahi chalata, aur phir existing patient ka har save fail hota hai.

Isliye checklist har Frappe rule ko ek standard se jodti hai (`get_all` nahi `frappe.get_list`, koi `allow_guest` nahi, parameters `values` mein, `reqd`/rename/retype ke liye patches, `log_error` ya `with_more_info` mein koi PHI nahi), aur skill woh facts batati hai jo reviewers galat samajhte hain: `get_all` koi permissions check nahi karta, `permission_query_conditions` sirf `get_list` ko affect karta hai, DocType JSON migrate par content hash se re-import hota hai, isliye missing `modified` bump finding nahi hai.

concepts.heading: FrappeTestCase aur bench run-tests par mapped test strategy
concepts.body_md:
`test-strategy` aath categories plan karti hai aur har ek ko us tooling se map karti hai jo Frappe v15 bench mein exist karti hai (`tooling-map.md`):

- **unit**: `api/mappers.py` par stdlib `unittest`, koi site nahi (`python -m unittest discover -s spice_lite/tests/unit -t .`). Koi pytest nahi: `run-tests --app` har `test_*.py` import karta hai, aur bench venv mein pytest hai hi nahi.
- **integration, api, negative, edge**: `FrappeTestCase` plus `tests/utils.py::call`, jo whitelisted function ko in-process call karta hai aur `(http_status, body)` return karta hai.
- **security**: do test users ke saath `frappe.set_user`, `frappe.guest_methods`, `frappe.allowed_http_methods_for_whitelisted_func`, aur User Permissions (`finally` mein delete, kyonki redis roll back nahi hota).
- **performance**: ek query counter.
- **regression**: existing tests plus defect id ke naam wale tests.

Commands `bench run-tests` ke sahi level par jaate hain: iteration ke liye `--module`, ek method ke liye `--test`, ek class ke liye `--case`, handoff se pehle `--app`, aur names ke liye `bench --verbose` (`run-tests --verbose` nahi).

Plan ke tests chalane se aise facts mile jo test design badalte hain:

- **Frappe v15.121.2 mein Postgres par `assertQueryCount` unusable hai.** Yeh apne message mein `last_query` values join karta hai, aur Postgres par woh `LazyDecode` objects hote hain: `TypeError: sequence item 0: expected str instance, LazyDecode found`, 1000 ki limit ke saath bhi. `mariadb.localhost` par wahi test pass hota hai. `testing-standards.md` performance smoke test ke liye `assertQueryCount` ka naam leta hai, isliye plan counter use karta hai aur framework defect ko regression test se pin karta hai.
- **Planted N+1 ke alawa teen `lastn` defects.** `system|code` token kuch match nahi karta; bina `effective_datetime` ke save hua `amended` Observation us final se haar jaata hai jise woh replace karta hai; bina value ka naya `preliminary` Observation `0.0` report hota hai (D-1). Har ek `@unittest.skip("SL-13x: ...")` test ke roop mein ship hota hai jo skip hatane par batayi wajah se fail hota hai.
- **Ek Java-edition defect yahan exist nahi karta.** Duplicate subjects `parse_subjects` collapse kar deta hai, isliye plan use report karne ki jagah passing test se pin karta hai.

Isliye practically: plan ka har `path:line` aur har "fails today" claim bench par chala kar check hota hai, padh kar nahi.

concepts.heading: Output contracts, golden cases, aur versioned assets ke roop mein skills
concepts.body_md:
Jis skill ka output shape har run mein badalta hai woh kisi doosre agent, CI, ya eval ko feed nahi kar sakti. Yahan har skill ka ek **output contract** aur ek **deterministic validator** hai (course pattern, built-in feature nahi):

| Skill | Contract | Validator kya check karta hai |
|---|---|---|
| `architecture-review` | `docs/adr/0000-template.md` ke H2 sections wala ADR, plus Requirement, Current architecture (evidence), Risks | section order, `Status: proposed`, 2+ options, `AR-NNN` risks, Verification mein `test_` names, har `path:line` resolve hota hai (`--repo`, `--bench`) |
| `code-review` | Summary, Findings, Details, Categories checked, Verdict | columns, severity aur category enums, sort order, (patched) file ke andar locations, quoted evidence, cited rule, severities se consistent verdict, `frappe.get_all` par switch karne ki koi advice nahi |
| `test-strategy` | Evidence ke saath scope, findings, cases, 8 categories par coverage | `TestClass#test_method` names, tool names, `existing` tests app mein exist karte hain aur `new` wale nahi, har category covered ya `N/A: reason`, ek `run-tests` exit criterion |

Validators `node:test` suites (10, 9 aur 10 tests) wale zero-dependency Node 22 scripts hain. Har ek `skills/<skill>/tests/cases.json` se ek **golden case** bhi grade karta hai: category ke hisaab se required findings, minimum severity, location aur evidence substrings; forbidden findings; expected verdict ya required citations.

Asset wala hissa `skills/<name>/` mein rehta hai (course convention): `README.md` (owner, consumers, invocation, files likhti hai ya nahi, test kaise karein), 1.0.0 par `CHANGELOG.md` (output-format change = major), aur `read:` ya `run:` marked `facts` wale golden cases. Isse nikalne wale release rules:

1. Naye checklist item ko ek golden case chahiye jo use trigger kare.
2. False-positive control (`cr-06-clean-test-only-change`) utna hi matter karta hai jitne bug cases.
3. Line numbers current app aur Frappe 15.121.2 se bandhe hain; `--repo` aur `--bench` drift ko failing check mein badal dete hain.
4. Live golden runs ko model chahiye (`claude -p "/code-review" --output-format json`); validators, patches aur example tests CI mein bina model ke chalte hain.

Module 09-agent-evaluation in cases ko agents ke liye chalata hai; module 10-governance skills ko package karta hai.

03-architecture-review-adr.title: architecture-review banao aur national health ID ke liye ADR-0002 draft karo
03-architecture-review-adr.objective: `architecture-review` skill banao (procedure, Frappe decision guide, ADR template, checklist, validator) aur ise requirement "Kenya deployment mein national health ID store, search, return aur verify karo" par chalao. Skill ko `context/architecture/overview.md`, ADR-0001, `search_patients` se `api/mappers.py` hote hue `hooks.py` tak ka path, aur woh Frappe source inspect karna chahiye jis par woh depend karti hai; core change vs country app vs integration app, controller vs `doc_events`, aur synchronous vs `frappe.enqueue` decide karna chahiye; codebase-specific risks list karne chahiye; aur status `proposed` ke saath `docs/adr/0002-national-health-id-integration-app.md` likhna chahiye jo `validate-adr.mjs --repo . --bench <bench> --status proposed` pass kare.

evaluationCriteria: Current behaviour ke baare mein har statement ek resolve hone wala `path:line` rakhta hai: repository paths `--repo` se, Frappe-source paths (`apps/frappe/...`) `--bench` se.
Placement axis explicitly decide hua hai (core, country app, integration app, extension point) aur har rejected placement batata hai ki woh is codebase mein kyon haarta hai.
Controller vs `doc_events` aur synchronous vs `frappe.enqueue` decide hue hain, concrete `queue`, `timeout`, `job_id` aur `deduplicate` values ke saath.

Risks spice_lite aur Frappe v15 ke liye specific hain (token parsing, fixed `PATIENT_FIELDS`, RQ job arguments, unique blank values, fixtures overwrite, `run-tests` ka migrate na karna), generic nahi.
Status `proposed` rehta hai; acceptance sirf PR review mein hoti hai.
`SKILL.md` sirf documented frontmatter keys use karta hai aur 500 lines se kam rehta hai, decision guide, template aur checklist supporting files ke roop mein.
improvements: Inspection phase `context: fork` aur `agent: Explore` ke saath chalao, phir ADR main session mein likho.
Un requirements ke liye golden cases jodo jinhe ADR nahi chahiye (ek controller method ke andar bug fix).
Skill ko sikhao ki ek chhoti table mein list kare ki kaunsi sites ko kaunsa app milta hai, aur module 06 ka automation ise `sites/apps.txt` ke against check kare (site config nahi).
Orchestrator (module 08-workflow-orchestration) ADR path ko automatically test-strategy ko pass kare (golden case `ts-05-national-health-id-adr`).

03-code-review-diff.title: code-review banao aur f-string SQL wale guest-accessible lookup ko review karo
03-code-review-diff.objective: Project `code-review` skill banao jo `AI-SDLC-frappe/` ke andar bundled `/code-review` ko replace kare, `!` commands se working-tree diff inject kare, Python, DocType JSON, `patches.txt`, `hooks.py` aur fixtures ko saath mein `context/standards/*` ke against review kare, aur verdict ke saath canonical format mein findings emit kare. Diya gaya patch apply karo (`allow_guest=True` wala front-desk `find_patients` method, `frappe.db.sql` ko pass kiya f-string, `frappe.log_error` mein search term, raw rows return, koi tests nahi), confirm karo ki suite green rehta hai, skill chalao, aur report validate karo.

evaluationCriteria: f-string SQL aur `allow_guest=True` ko do alag critical security findings ke roop mein dhoondhta hai, har ek apna rule cite karta hai (`frappe-coding-standards.md#4`, `#3`).
`frappe.db.sql` ke permission bypass, `frappe.log_error` mein PHI, D-5 wildcard regression aur raw-row return ko alag root causes ke roop mein flag karta hai.
Evidence diff se verbatim hai ya quoted probe output; locations post-patch line numbers use karti hain jo patched file mein exist karte hain (`--repo` pass hota hai).
Aath mein se har category ids ya `no findings` ke roop mein listed hai.
`lastn` mein `TEACHING-DEFECT(perf-n+1)` report nahi karta, jise diff chhoota nahi.
Verdict review-standards.md follow karta hai (koi bhi critical ya high matlab BLOCK) aur use merge approval nahi bataya gaya.
improvements: Custom `agent: reviewer` ke saath `context: fork` jodo taaki lamba diff main session ka context na bhare.
GitHub MCP server ke through findings ko inline PR comments ke roop mein post karo (module 06-mcp-and-tooling-architecture).
`test_whitelisted_methods_are_not_guest_accessible` ko (bug-fix workflow ke through) extend karo taaki woh `spice_lite.api.fhir` ke har function par iterate kare, aur naya guest method CI fail kare.
Desk edits overwrite karne wale fixture aur bina `queue`/`timeout` ke `frappe.enqueue` ke liye golden cases jodo.

Plan ke naye cases implement karo, bench par prove karo ki `new` wale pass hote hain aur `new-failing` wale documented wajahon se fail hote hain, aur baad mein test files app se hata do.

evaluationCriteria: Saari aath categories cover karta hai, har ek ek concrete `TestClass#test_method` aur Frappe v15 bench mein exist karne wale tool ke saath.
Real harness use karta hai: `tests/utils.py` helpers, do test users, per-class rollback, redis-cached User Permissions ka explicit cleanup.
Token, undated-amendment aur zero-value behaviour dhoondhta hai, sirf planted N+1 nahi, aur duplicate-subject behaviour ko dobara report nahi karta jo `parse_subjects` pehle se handle karta hai.

Har patch `git apply --check --directory=$(git rev-parse --show-prefix)` se apply hota hai, aur `testsAfterPatch` real suite result record karta hai, DocType changes ke liye migrate caveat samet.
